# Software Engineering Guide

> An open guidebook of software engineering best practices for large developer teams, including enterprise and government: 147 chapters (called topics) across 12 parts, plus front matter and appendices, in a warm, plain, opinionated style.

The guide is published in several locales. The English locale below is the default; every other locale uses the same URL pattern with its own code and topics segment, and the full list of topics per locale is in llms.json.

## Start here

- [Home](https://software-engineering-guide.github.io/en-us/): the opening page
- [Contents](https://software-engineering-guide.github.io/en-us/contents/): all parts and topics

## For contributors and agents

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/software-engineering-guide/software-engineering-guide/blob/main/AGENTS.md): repository orientation and the golden rules
- [spec/](https://github.com/software-engineering-guide/software-engineering-guide/tree/main/spec): the specification, the single source of truth
- [llms.json](https://software-engineering-guide.github.io/llms.json): the same information, machine-readable, for every locale
